name: JOCN cross-domain dataset revision evaluation bundle
description: Machine-readable metadata for two distinct 339-km NDFF Voyager campaigns, the processed wireless telemetry and materialised constructed-fusion table, the per-run evaluation artefacts, and the final W4C synthetic three-RAT wireless dataset used in the major-revision experiments. The optical and wireless measurements come from separate campaigns and are associated only through an explicitly constructed positional benchmark; they are not time-synchronised measurements of one physical event.

distribution.name: Processed wireless telemetry
distribution.description: Thirty-second wireless telemetry table containing 5G, Wi-Fi and LiFi measurements plus service and wireless-domain labels.

distribution.name: Christmas 2025 raw Voyager optical telemetry
distribution.description: A separate 2025-12-22 to 2026-01-24 campaign on the 339-km NDFF loop, containing 20,960 valid timestamped bit-error-rate records for eight Voyager channels. Real timestamps and 38 embedded headers from 39 acquisition segments are preserved in the source file. Consecutive valid records are mostly 70 to 72 seconds apart, with acquisition gaps, and the data were not resampled to 15-minute intervals.

distribution.name: 2023--2024 processed Voyager optical telemetry
distribution.description: The earlier, distinct 339-km NDFF campaign: 1,373 processed 15-minute records from 2023-12-26 to 2024-01-26, with four BER channels and four derived Q-factor columns.

distribution.name: Practical wireless field inventory
distribution.description: Complete inventory of the 46 practical wireless telemetry columns. The public source file does not declare physical units for the numeric fields; those entries are explicitly marked as not documented.

distribution.name: Semantic utility results
distribution.description: Per-seed downstream-utility metrics for all evaluated semantic representations and baselines.

distribution.name: Privacy attack results
distribution.description: Per-seed attribute-inference results for multiple attacker families, targets and representations.

distribution.name: Materialised constructed optical--wireless interoperability benchmark
distribution.description: The exact 2,848-row leakage-controlled E1/E2 table produced by positional sequence mapping of non-contemporaneous optical and wireless campaigns. It records source-row indices, chronological split membership, training-only label thresholds, current-record inputs, and next-record targets. It is a constructed representation benchmark, not a jointly measured physical session.

distribution.name: Unique GNPy configuration audit
distribution.description: Deduplicated GNPy scenario configurations and returned physical-layer metrics used for the revision audit.

distribution.name: Recovered-source GNPy replay results
distribution.description: Case-level comparison of a pinned GNPy v2.12 compatibility replay and a schema-corrected GNPy 2.14.2 strict run against 96 archived results.

distribution.name: Final W4C synthetic application-flow dataset
distribution.description: Final synthetic three-RAT ns-3.44 application-flow table with 432 records: 144 NR, 144 Wi-Fi 802.11ax, and 144 LiFi records from 48 configurations.

distribution.name: W4C run-level KPI summaries
distribution.description: Run-level summaries obtained after averaging the three CPE application flows within each access branch.

distribution.name: W4C LiFi optical-state summaries
distribution.description: Per-run and per-CPE summaries of the sampled equation-driven LOS LiFi/OWC state variables.

distribution.name: W4C structural validation summary
distribution.description: Structural validation summary for the 48-run W4C sweep, including application-flow counts and mapping status.

distribution.name: W4C field dictionary
distribution.description: Field names, units, and descriptions for the final application-flow and sampled optical-state tables.

distribution.name: W4C release documentation
distribution.description: Release documentation for the project-local ns-3 source, configuration, per-run outputs, LiFi validation files, and analysis results for the final W4C dataset.

distribution.name: W4C ns-3 source
distribution.description: Project-local integrated ns-3 source for the final three-RAT scenario.

distribution.name: Representative W4C optical-state table
distribution.description: Representative optical_state.csv file documenting the schema repeated in the per-run W4C optical-state outputs.

distribution.name: W4C final sweep report
distribution.description: Observed structural checks, bounded factor analysis, validation evidence, and claim boundaries for the final W4C synthetic wireless dataset.
